about: The sound department's cue sheet. Everything is keyed by shot id and seconds from the start of that shot ('t'), or by a moment in timeline.CUES ('cue', then 't' is an offset from it). Never film time: post/mix.py adds the shot starts and the edit from timeline.py. 'END' is the end card. Levels are dB. Bed names are files in sound/lib (sound/fetch_lib.py).
peak_round_about: Phones and laptops: aim for -16 LUFS with the true peak under -1 dBTP. Wooden knocks are nearly all peak, so one gain cannot get there; up to peak_round_db may be bent off the tips of the knocks by a fixed curve with no memory (not a limiter: it cannot pump). 0 switches it off. Check the film's own encode too: AAC rebuilds knocks about 1.7 dB above the WAV's peak (post/compose.py takes 1 dB off).
levels_about: One fixed level per layer: ambience, generated music stems (the track has its own level: music.track.under_action_lu), steps, effects.

room.about: a little of steps + fx through a small synthetic room, so the close recordings sit in the house

ambience.about: Per shot: the beds that play, each with a level and a tone. A shot not listed uses by_light for its light state (timeline.SHOTS). On every cut the beds cross-fade in 30 ms, so the room moves with the camera: wide shots hear the room, macro shots hear the object.

track.about: The music: sound/music/track.<ext> (any format ffmpeg reads). While that file exists it is the ONLY music and the rest of this 'music' block (the generated stems) is off. start = seconds into the recording that play at 'at' on the film ('at': {shot, t}; left out = the film's first frame). The picture is cut on this recording at start 0, speed 1: do not change 'start'. LEVEL: one fixed gain for the whole film, set against the action and not against the file: under_action_lu = how many LU the music's loudness (BS.1770, gated) sits under the action's loud passages (the loudness steps + fx + room pass 5 % of the time); 'db' trims it. hp / lp = optional tone, Hz. fade_in seconds. ENDING: 'splices' leave the recording at 'out' and pick it up at 'in' (seconds in the recording; each join is an equal-power cross-fade 'xfade' long, centred on those times), and/or fade_out = seconds of fade that end with the film (0 = none). no_tune: true stops the mix from tuning pitched effects to the music under them.

music.about: No track: no music (sound/music/track.* is not in git: put the film's track there; CC0 / public domain, or one the film is licensed to use).

accent_guard.about: In a shot whose accent kind is named here, a guarded kind that falls within 'window' seconds of the accent is moved to 'delay' seconds after it and turned by 'db', so the big hit is heard alone first.

shots.about: Per-shot trims: steps_db / fx_db (how close the camera is), surface (what things stand on when a kind does not say), kinds: {kind: {db, st, hp, lp}}.

extra_about: One-off sounds the sets do not send. Same form as build/<set>/events.json ('shot', 't', 'kind', 'gain', 'dur'), or 'cue' for a moment in timeline.CUES ('t' is then an offset), or 'file' to play one library file ('db', 'st', 'hp', 'lp', 'pan', 'dur').
